//: Source of the shared row classes of ontola/atomic-plugins#177 (option 4). `node ontology-kit/ontology.mjs build` turns this plus base.json into the published term files under ontology/ and the subject constants in terms.mjs. A reference in requires, recommends or classtype is either a term defined here (a property shortname, or a class name) or an absolute URL of an existing term that is reused, never copied. Published terms never change: a change of meaning gets a new shortname or class version (see ontology-kit/README.md). Every term is declared, not verified.

v1.name: Shared row classes v1
v1.description: Row classes that several atomic-plugins drive apps sync into, so a plugin's view works on any table of that class (ontola/atomic-plugins#177). Declared, not verified: no plugin writes these classes yet.

v2.name: Learning tree v2
v2.description: Skill, lesson and mastery classes for learning trees (Leerboom). Property names follow schema.org LRMI where one fits: teaches, competencyRequired, timeRequired. Assessments, questions and attempts are not part of this release. Declared, not verified.

v3.name: Learning tree v3
v3.description: Deck, cohort, assignment, submission, grade, question, assessment and attempt classes for teaching with learning trees (Leerboom). Property names follow schema.org LRMI where one fits: teaches, assesses, license. Credentials (Open Badges) are not part of this release. Declared, not verified.

event-v1.name: Event
event-v1.description: A calendar event. Placed by its first civil day and, for multi-day or all-day events, its exclusive end day; timed events also carry their exact start and end instants as RFC 3339 strings with offset. Provider data (ids, ETags, links, sync baselines) is not part of this class.

issue-v1.name: Issue
issue-v1.description: An issue or task, using the task/v1 vocabulary every AtomicServer embeds: status (todo, doing, blocked, done; done is closed), body, assignee and due date. Provider data (issue numbers, labels, comments, sync state) is not part of this class.

time-entry-v1.name: Time entry
time-entry-v1.description: One interval of work: a start instant, an end instant (absent while a timer runs), and optionally a project, a person and a billable flag. Provider data (source ids, observation logs) is not part of this class.

work-project-v1.name: Project
work-project-v1.description: A named body of work that time entries belong to.

work-person-v1.name: Person
work-person-v1.description: A person who performed work, by name. Not an Atomic authentication agent.

bank-transaction-v1.name: Bank transaction
bank-transaction-v1.description: A booked bank transaction: account, currency, an exact signed decimal amount and a value date, plus the bank's own narrative and reference and the person's own category and note. Import bookkeeping (source ids, fingerprints, statement numbers) is not part of this class.

skill-v1.name: Skill
skill-v1.description: A unit of knowledge in a learning tree, with the skills it requires and recommends. The tree belongs to everyone who can read it; whether a skill is open is computed per learner from their own mastery rows.

lesson-v1.name: Lesson
lesson-v1.description: One route to a skill: a thin wrapper around the real material (video, document, exercise, live session). A skill may have many lessons.

mastery-v1.name: Mastery
mastery-v1.description: How well one learner masters one skill. Private data, kept in the learner's own drive. Not a credential: nobody attests it.

deck-v1.name: Deck
deck-v1.description: An ordered list of slides, each an ordinary resource. Used as the content of a lesson (lesson-format slides) or on its own.

cohort-v1.name: Cohort
cohort-v1.description: A group of learners with their teachers and the skills they work towards. Access follows the usual drive rights; the class adds no permission model.

assignment-v1.name: Assignment
assignment-v1.description: Work given to a cohort on a skill, with an optional lesson and a due date.

submission-v1.name: Submission
submission-v1.description: One learner's handing in of the work for one assignment. Status is one of todo, in-progress, submitted, reviewed.

grade-v1.name: Grade
grade-v1.description: A teacher's judgment of one learner on an assignment or assessment, with scale and weight. Not mastery (what a learner can do) and not an Open Badge or other credential.

question-v1.name: Question
question-v1.description: One question of an assessment, a row in a question table. Also usable as a slide in a deck.

assessment-v1.name: Assessment
assessment-v1.description: A set of questions that checks skills, for practice or as attested evidence.

attempt-v1.name: Attempt
attempt-v1.description: One try at an assessment by one learner. Append-only, kept in the learner's own drive. Comparable to the result of an xAPI statement.

atomic-calendar-day.name: Day
atomic-calendar-day.description: First civil day of the event (YYYY-MM-DD), in the event's own time zone as the provider gives it. The shortname is the one AtomicServer's built-in Calendar view matches (calendarFields).

atomic-calendar-end-day.name: End day
atomic-calendar-end-day.description: Exclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD) of a multi-day or all-day event: the first day it no longer covers. Absent means a single day.

atomic-calendar-all-day.name: All day
atomic-calendar-all-day.description: Whether the event lasts whole days. Absent means false.

atomic-calendar-start.name: Start
atomic-calendar-start.description: Exact start instant of a timed event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with its UTC offset, exactly as the provider gave it. A string rather than a timestamp, so the offset is kept.

atomic-calendar-end.name: End
atomic-calendar-end.description: Exact exclusive end instant of a timed event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with its UTC offset.

atomic-calendar-location.name: Location
atomic-calendar-location.description: Where the event takes place, as free text.

atomic-calendar-notes.name: Notes
atomic-calendar-notes.description: The event's description, as plain text.

atomic-calendar-recurrence.name: Recurrence
atomic-calendar-recurrence.description: Recurrence rule, in the JSON payload AtomicServer's calendar-recurrence reads (browser/lib/src/calendar-recurrence.ts).

work-start.name: Start
work-start.description: Start instant of a work interval, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

work-end.name: End
work-end.description: End instant of a completed work interval, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent while a timer is running.

work-project.name: Project
work-project.description: Project this work interval belongs to.

work-billable.name: Billable
work-billable.description: Whether this work interval is marked billable. Does not imply invoicing or payment.

bank-account.name: Account
bank-account.description: Account identifier: an IBAN when the bank gives one, otherwise the bank's own account id.

bank-currency.name: Currency
bank-currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amount.

bank-amount.name: Amount
bank-amount.description: Exact signed decimal string in the account currency, at most 5 fraction digits. Negative is money out; positive is money in.

bank-value-date.name: Value date
bank-value-date.description: Bank value date (YYYY-MM-DD), without an inferred time zone.

bank-description.name: Description
bank-description.description: The bank's original narrative for the transaction, verbatim.

bank-reference.name: Reference
bank-reference.description: Bank reference, or customer reference if the bank gives none.

money-category.name: Category
money-category.description: The person's own category for this transaction, as free text. Never written by an importer.

money-note.name: Note
money-note.description: The person's own note on this transaction. Never written by an importer.

skill-requires.name: Requires
skill-requires.description: Skills that must be mastered before this one. Advisory: a view may show a skill as locked but never refuses to open it. Maps to schema.org competencyRequired.

skill-recommends.name: Recommends
skill-recommends.description: Skills that help with this one but are never needed.

skill-equivalent-to.name: Equivalent to
skill-equivalent-to.description: The same skill in another tree or drive. Equivalent skills are merged when trees are combined, so mastering one counts for all.

skill-level.name: Level
skill-level.description: Rough difficulty, 1 and up, for layout and filters. Not a prerequisite.

skill-mastery-threshold.name: Mastery threshold
skill-mastery-threshold.description: Mastery level from 0 to 1 at which this skill counts as mastered. Absent: the view default, 0.8.

lesson-teaches.name: Teaches
lesson-teaches.description: Skills this lesson helps with. Maps to schema.org teaches.

lesson-content.name: Content
lesson-content.description: The material: a resource (document, file, canvas, plugin view, tour) or an external https link.

lesson-format.name: Format
lesson-format.description: One of video, text, interactive, exercise, live, tour. A view shows an unknown value as plain text.

lesson-minutes.name: Minutes
lesson-minutes.description: Estimated duration in minutes. Maps to schema.org timeRequired.

lesson-language.name: Language
lesson-language.description: BCP 47 language code of the material, for example nl or en.

mastery-skill.name: Skill
mastery-skill.description: The skill this mastery is about.

mastery-level.name: Level
mastery-level.description: How well the learner masters the skill, 0 to 1.

mastery-source.name: Source
mastery-source.description: Where the level comes from: one of attempt, lesson, self, endorsement.

mastery-updated-at.name: Updated at
mastery-updated-at.description: When the level was last set, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

deck-slides.name: Slides
deck-slides.description: The slides, in presentation order (the array order is the order). A slide is any existing resource: a document fragment, a canvas, a file, a question, a plugin view.

deck-teaches.name: Teaches
deck-teaches.description: Skills this deck helps with. Same meaning as lesson-teaches, for a deck that is used as the content of a lesson. Maps to schema.org teaches Points at skill-v1.

cohort-teachers.name: Teachers
cohort-teachers.description: The agents who guide this cohort and may read its learners' shared mastery and write grades.

cohort-goals.name: Goals
cohort-goals.description: Skills this cohort works towards Points at skill-v1.

assignment-cohort.name: Cohort
assignment-cohort.description: The cohort this assignment is for.

assignment-skill.name: Skill
assignment-skill.description: The skill the assignment practises Points at skill-v1.

assignment-lesson.name: Lesson
assignment-lesson.description: The lesson to use for the assignment. Optional Points at lesson-v1.

assignment-due.name: Due
assignment-due.description: When the assignment is due, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

submission-student.name: Student
submission-student.description: The learner who hands in the work.

submission-work.name: Work
submission-work.description: The submitted work: any resource, for example a document, a file or a canvas.

submission-submitted-at.name: Submitted at
submission-submitted-at.description: When the work was handed in, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

submission-status.name: Status
submission-status.description: One of todo, in-progress, submitted, reviewed. A view shows an unknown value as plain text.

grade-student.name: Student
grade-student.description: The learner who received the grade.

grade-assignment.name: Assignment
grade-assignment.description: The assignment that was graded. Give this or grade-assessment.

grade-assessment.name: Assessment
grade-assessment.description: The assessment that was graded. Give this or grade-assignment.

grade-value.name: Value
grade-value.description: The grade as written on its scale, for example 7.5, 85, B or pass. A string, so that every scale fits.

grade-scale.name: Scale
grade-scale.description: How to read the value: one of 1-10, percent, A-F, pass-fail.

grade-weight.name: Weight
grade-weight.description: Weight of this grade in an average. Absent: 1.

grade-evidence.name: Evidence
grade-evidence.description: The attempt or submission that was judged.

grade-graded-at.name: Graded at
grade-graded-at.description: When the grade was given, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

question-prompt.name: Prompt
question-prompt.description: The question as shown to the learner.

question-type.name: Type
question-type.description: One of choice, numeric, short-text. A view shows an unknown value as plain text.

question-options.name: Options
question-options.description: For a choice question, the options as a JSON array of strings. The repository has no tag convention yet; a later release may point to tag resources instead.

question-answer.name: Answer
question-answer.description: The correct answer: for a choice question the text of the right option, for numeric a number written as text, for short-text the accepted text. Used for practice with direct feedback; an attested assessment keeps its key elsewhere.

question-skill.name: Skill
question-skill.description: The skill this question checks Points at skill-v1.

assessment-assesses.name: Assesses
assessment-assesses.description: Skills this assessment checks. Maps to schema.org assesses Points at skill-v1.

assessment-questions.name: Questions
assessment-questions.description: The question bank: a table whose rows are question-v1 resources.

assessment-pass-score.name: Pass score
assessment-pass-score.description: Score from 0 to 1 at which the assessed skills count as mastered.

assessment-kind.name: Kind
assessment-kind.description: One of practice, attested. Practice is for learning with direct feedback; attested is a test whose result may count as evidence.

attempt-answers.name: Answers
attempt-answers.description: The learner's answers as JSON, keyed by the subject of each question.

attempt-created-at.name: Created at
attempt-created-at.description: When the attempt was made, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

lesson-license.name: License
lesson-license.description: The license of the material, as an SPDX identifier or a URL. Maps to schema.org license. For a future lesson-v2 to recommend.

lesson-generated-with.name: Generated with
lesson-generated-with.description: The tool or model that generated the material, if any, for example the model name. For a future lesson-v2 to recommend.
